sidecar.TaskDescription: Continuous intensive-care EEG monitoring of a comatose patient after cardiac arrest; no task was performed.
sidecar.InstitutionName: I-CARE consortium (seven hospitals in the United States and Europe)

split.Description: The release's folder: the 2023 PhysioNet Challenge partition.

hospital.Description: De-identified source hospital, as the release's patient file gives it.

age.Description: Age at the cardiac arrest; ages above 89 are given as 90.

sex.Description: Sex, as the release's patient file gives it.

rosc.Description: Time from the cardiac arrest to the return of spontaneous circulation (ROSC).

shockable_rhythm.Description: Initial rhythm shockable (ventricular fibrillation); the release's field `Shockable Rhythm` or `VFib`.

ttm.Description: Targeted temperature management setpoint; n/a when none was applied.

outcome.Description: Neurological outcome, from the Cerebral Performance Category (CPC).
